entities.name: José Valdez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Alfredo Valdez is a Dominican former professional baseball pitcher. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Detroit Tigers, Los Angeles Angels, San Diego Padres and San Francisco Giants. He has also played in the Chinese Professional Baseball League (CPBL) for the CTBC Brothers and Fubon Guardians.
